claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 August 1866, p. 5, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
The small ship Red-White-and-Blue, which
sailed from New York on the 9th of July, with
two men and a dog on board, passed here to-
day, bound to London; all well. The names
of the men on board are Captain William
Hudson and his mate, Fitch. [Hastings is a
small port in the English Channel, about
thirty-three miles from Brighton.]
